_doc: Difficulty levers (GDD 4.23, D7) [balance]. Chosen when the game is created and saved in WorldState.difficulty. Each lever enters with its system; H3: start_debt (GDD 4.16, the loan of the start), rival_craft and rival_sell_min_demand (the rival smith, GDD 4.5.5: they replace the profile's figures), buy_price_mult (market purchase price). The targets of data/targets.json are those of normal.
